domain-information: A Client requests a landscaping service to improve their garden or yard.
A Client provides details about their property so the designer can create a tailored plan.
A Landscape Designer assesses the property to develop a design concept.
A Landscape Designer prepares a project plan to outline required materials and tasks.
A Crew Member performs tasks according to the project plan.
A Crew Member reports low supply of materials to ensure the project can continue.
A Supply Manager orders new plants and tools to restock inventory.
A Supply Manager confirms delivery of landscaping materials to ensure readiness for upcoming projects.
A Landscape Designer reviews completed work to ensure it matches the original design.

domain objects.name: Landscaping Request
domain objects.description: Initial request from a Client describing desired landscaping work.

domain objects.name: Property Details
domain objects.description: Information about the Client’s property relevant to design and planning.

domain objects.name: Landscape Designer
domain objects.description: Professional responsible for creating design concepts and project plans.

domain objects.name: Design Concept
domain objects.description: Proposed visual and functional layout for the Client’s landscape.

domain objects.name: Project Plan
domain objects.description: Detailed plan defining required Materials and Tasks for the project.

domain objects.name: Material
domain objects.description: Item such as plants or tools needed to complete landscaping tasks.

domain objects.name: Task
domain objects.description: Work unit required to carry out the Project Plan.

domain objects.name: Crew Member
domain objects.description: Worker performing Tasks defined in the Project Plan.

domain objects.name: Supply Shortage Report
domain objects.description: Report indicating insufficient Materials during project execution.

domain objects.name: Supply Manager
domain objects.description: Person responsible for monitoring inventory and ordering Materials.

domain objects.name: Inventory
domain objects.description: Collection of available Materials for ongoing and future projects.

domain objects.name: Supply Order
domain objects.description: Request sent to a Supplier to replenish needed Materials.

domain objects.name: Supply Delivery
domain objects.description: Shipment of Materials arriving from a Supplier.

domain objects.name: Landscaping Review
domain objects.description: Evaluation by the Landscape Designer comparing completed work to the design.

associations.description: Client submits a Landscaping Request to initiate a new project.
Landscape Designer reviews the Landscaping Request to understand client needs.
Landscape Designer creates a Design Concept based on project requirements.
Landscape Designer produces a Project Plan that specifies Tasks and Materials.
Design Concept informs the structure and content of the Project Plan.
Crew Member follows the Project Plan to perform the required Tasks.
Landscape Designer performs a Landscaping Review to verify project completion quality.
Crew Member creates a Supply Shortage Report when Materials are insufficient.
Supply Shortage Report notifies the Supply Manager about low Materials.
Supply Manager issues a Supply Order to obtain needed Materials.
Supply Order requests Material fulfillment from the Supplier.
Supplier provides a Supply Delivery to send Materials.
Supply Delivery is received and confirmed by the Supply Manager.
Supply Manager updates Inventory with new Materials.
